events.verdict: Booker (PHX) legally contests Jones' (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Jones (NOP) initiates contact with Booker's (PHX) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Beal (PHX) legally contests McCollum's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Beal (PHX) establishes himself in Jones' (NOP) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the pick.
McCollum (NOP) extends his arm toward the ball and marginal contact occurs as he brushes Booker's (PHX) off-arm on the perimeter.
McCollum (NOP) initiates contact with Booker's (PHX) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Allen (PHX) is moving alongside McCollum's (NOP) path and when he reaches in, he brushes McCollum's arm during his driving shot attempt.
McCollum (NOP) legally contests Allen's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Ighodaro (PHX) and Jones (NOP) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Booker (PHX) brings his hand toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Ingram's (NOP) body during the steal attempt.

Murphy III (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds after deflecting the throw-in. There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms if Murphy III crosses the boundary line in order to deflect the pass.
Murray (NOP) legally contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Jones (NOP) and Beal (PHX) both make clean contact with the ball in their attempts to secure the rebound. Any follow-through contact after the ball is cleanly deflected away is deemed incidental.
Booker (PHX) briefly grasps and quickly releases Murphy III's (NOP) jersey as Murphy III sets his intended screen during the inbound.
Ighodaro (PHX) commits a take foul on McCollum (NOP).
Jones (NOP) extends his hand toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Booker's (PHX) right arm after he releases his dribble back to his left hand.
Both Jones (NOP) and Murphy III (NOP) are in a legal guarding position during Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt. Murphy III jumps vertically and absorbs the contact initiated by Booker.
